evidence.excerpt: We present the first robustness validation of six VLMs (drawn from the Gemma, InternVL, LLaVA, and Qwen families) and five VLAs (drawn from the GR00T, OpenVLA, and $π$ families) over entire continuous regions of photometric and geometric image perturbation: brightness shifts, camera rotations, and their composition.
